data.camera_radius_definition: Maximum Euclidean distance from a training camera center to the arithmetic mean of all 24 unperturbed training camera centers, in the normalized model frame
data.rotation_convention: For each non-anchor camera, left-multiply its camera-to-world rotation by a fixed-angle Rodrigues rotation about a noise-seed-determined axis in the model/world frame; camera center is unchanged
data.translation_convention: For each non-anchor camera, add a noise-seed-determined unit vector in the model/world frame times translation_fraction times camera_radius; orientation is unchanged
data.anchor: Training camera at parser index 0 is unchanged; expected names are DSCF5566.JPG for bonsai and DSCF4668.JPG for room
